name: GFSM economic classification
description: The IMF's Government Finance Statistics Manual, main categories only. COFOG says what the money is for. This says what kind of transaction it is - salaries, goods, interest, capital. Publishers can still use fuller GFSM subcodes as the value.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Grants received
hasDefinedTerm.description: Grants, including money from other governments.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Other revenue
hasDefinedTerm.description: Fees, fines, sales of goods and services, and income from property.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Compensation of employees
hasDefinedTerm.description: Wages, salaries, and social contributions paid to employees.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Grants paid
hasDefinedTerm.description: Grants paid, including to other governments.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Nonfinancial assets
hasDefinedTerm.description: Buying or selling fixed assets, like buildings or equipment.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Financial assets
hasDefinedTerm.description: Buying or selling financial assets, like shares or loans made.
